summary: Agnico Eagle Mines Limited filed a Form 6-K on July 27, 2026, disclosing a subscription agreement with Cadillac Mines Corporation. Agnico Eagle agreed to acquire 8,696,000 common shares at C$6.90 per share, totaling C$60,002,400, increasing its stake to about 11.09% post-IPO. The private placement is contingent on Cadillac's IPO closing. Agnico Eagle will enter a lock-up agreement restricting disposal of shares. This is a strategic minority investment, not a controlling acquisition. The deal is expected to close around August 5, 2026. Watch for regulatory approval and IPO completion.
